dogecoin.text: Has there been a bigger month in #Crypto news? First Bill Maher goes on a Boomerific rant against it (which 90% of his points apply to fiat currency), then Elon Musk pushes #Dogecoin during the SN15 landing and SNL, then the pipeline hackers get paid in it (probably in #Monero).

Bitcoin Pizza is good for amplifying the #crypto message but massively blunders by not allowing us to USE crypto to buy some!
Perfect opportunity right now for someone to create #Dogecoin Pizza, where you can also, you know, USE Dogecoin to buy some. Guaranteed customers.
